issues.detail: The Hebrew has בַּעֲלָ֛ת (Baalath) and תָּמָר (Tamar). The Chinese renders בַּעֲלָ֛ת as '巴亞勒他' (Ba-ya-le-ta), which appears to add an extra syllable '他' (ta) not present in the Hebrew name. The correct transliteration should be '巴亞勒' (Ba-ya-le) or similar, without the extra '他'. This changes the proper name.
